provider: NASA POWER (Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources), NASA LaRC

svalbard.name: Svalbard & Barents Sea (Arctic)
svalbard.why: Arctic amplification: the fastest-warming region on Earth in most records.

sahel.name: Central Sahel (Niger–Mali–Burkina Faso)
sahel.why: Rainfall collapsed in the 1970s–80s droughts and has partly recovered since.

amazon.name: Southern Amazon (Rondônia–Mato Grosso)
amazon.why: Deforestation arc: warming and drying of the land surface are reported.

california.name: California Central Valley & Sierra Nevada
california.why: Repeated megadrought years; soil moisture and snow are water-supply indicators.

delhi.name: Delhi & Upper Indo-Gangetic Plain
delhi.why: Heavy aerosol pollution can dim sunlight reaching the ground.

murray.name: Murray–Darling Basin (SE Australia)
murray.why: Large swings between drought (Millennium Drought) and floods.

sfbay.name: San Francisco Bay–Delta Estuary
sfbay.why: Estuary where land, ocean and atmosphere meet; coastal fog and heat matter.

T2M.label: Air temperature (2 m)
T2M.definition: How warm the air is about head-height above the ground, averaged over the month.

T2M_MAX.label: Daily maximum temperature (2 m)
T2M_MAX.definition: The hottest temperature reached each day, averaged over the month — a heat indicator.

PRECTOTCORR.label: Precipitation (bias-corrected)
PRECTOTCORR.definition: Rain plus snow (as water) falling per day, corrected toward gauge/satellite observations.

EVLAND.label: Evaporation from land
EVLAND.definition: Water returned from soil, plants and lakes to the air each day (evapotranspiration).

GWETROOT.label: Root-zone soil wetness
GWETROOT.definition: How full the soil's root zone (top ~1 m) is with water: 0 = bone dry, 1 = saturated.

RH2M.label: Relative humidity (2 m)
RH2M.definition: How close the air is to being saturated with water vapor.

QV2M.label: Specific humidity (2 m)
QV2M.definition: Grams of water vapor in each kilogram of air — the actual amount of moisture.

WS10M.label: Wind speed (10 m)
WS10M.definition: Average wind speed 10 meters above the surface.

ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN.label: Sunlight reaching the ground
ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN.definition: Solar energy arriving at the surface through clouds and haze. Falls when air is dirtier or cloudier.

CLOUD_AMT.label: Cloud amount
CLOUD_AMT.definition: Percentage of the sky covered by cloud.

SNODP.label: Snow depth
SNODP.definition: How deep the snow on the ground is, averaged over the month.
